name: Pitch by Pitch All Sports Summer Day Camp
description_short: Coed all sports day camp for ages 6 to 13 at Congers Lake Memorial Park (weeks 1 to 6) and Lake Nanuet Park (weeks 7 and 8), with drills, games and weekly tournaments in sports like wiffleball, soccer, basketball and flag football, Friday color wars, weekly mental skills lessons and time in the town pool.
notes: Full day 9 am to 3 pm, $300 a week (early bird $280 for the first 65 families); half day 9 am to noon, $190 a week. Sign up by the week. Extended morning drop off from 7:30 am for an added fee (amount not posted). Campers without a Clarkstown seasonal pool pass pay a small daily pool fee (amount not posted). Sibling and multiweek discounts on request.
